models_evaluated: Jvion Care Optimization and Recommendation Enhancement (CORE)

links.outcome: Change in ED visits and admissions after risk-prediction-driven nurse outreach
links.effect: Monthly ED visits per 100 OCM patients fell from 13.7 to 11.5 (18%); quarterly admissions fell from 19.5 to 17.1 (13%). This was a pre-post comparison with no control group.
links.quote: Per 100 unique OCM patients, monthly ED visits dropped from 13.7 to 11.5 (18%), a sustained month-over-month improvement.

unlisted_practices: Nurse case manager outreach every 1-2 weeks after initial contact to maintain adherence to AI-generated patient-specific recommendations
Use of Plan-Do-Study-Act methodology for iterative AI implementation

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment of an AI risk prediction tool combined with proactive nurse case management to reduce acute care utilization in an oncology practice.

primary.practice: nurse outreach driven by risk-based prescriptive analytics
